ux-agent/tool-names-and-descriptions: 'small eval of five tasks, report tool-selection accuracy' is n=5, which supports no checkable rule. Set a task count and a pass threshold, or make the deliverable a description checklist rather than an accuracy claim.

ux-verify/evidence-and-claims: 'unaided LLM review of two diffs, count true, false and unverifiable claims' has no ground truth beyond axe plus one manual pass, and n=2. Weak as a measurement. Primary source for the synthetic-users part says only 'dates as RM25 and RM26 state them', with no URL.
